releases.title: Checklists in Notes
notes: Make to-do lists inside notes: tap the checklist button to turn lines into checklist items.
Tap a box to check an item off. Done items are crossed out.
Press Return on an item to start the next one, or Return on an empty item to finish the list.
The Notes list shows how many items are checked off, like 2/5.
Ask the assistant to add to a checklist ("add sunscreen to my packing list") and it adds a new item.

releases.title: Simpler To-Dos & Talk Popup
notes: New To-Do adds an empty row to the list, ready to type, with no pop-up. Press Return or tap anywhere else when you're done.
The To-Do list is now a simple list on the gray background, without sections. Completed to-dos sit in a compact list at the bottom.
Pressing Return or tapping elsewhere now always finishes editing a to-do.
Deadlines use your quick times from To-Do settings, and you can still pick any date and time.
Fixed the deadline date and time not showing and not responding to taps.
Quick times in settings sit on one row and are never cut off. Tap one to change or remove it.
The Live Talk button in Control Center opens a pop-up at the top of the screen with your conversation, where you can type to the assistant without opening the app.
The Up Next widget shows how many to-dos you have next to its title and uses its full height. The ✦ button stays in the corner.
In a note, Done is now a round checkmark button with more space above the keyboard.
Notes no longer jump up when you open the Notes tab.

releases.title: Alarm Sounds & Quick Times
notes: Choose a sound for each alarm: Default, Chime, Beacon, Pulse, Rise or Bells. Tap one to hear it.
Pick your own quick times for to-do deadlines in To-Do settings. They're 9 AM, 3 PM and 9 PM to start, and show just the time.
Touch and hold a to-do's notification to be reminded in an hour or tomorrow.
The alarm heads-up notification simply says when it rings.
Tapping an alarm in a widget opens the Alarms tab, and tapping a to-do opens that to-do. Every part of a row now opens it.
The Up Next widget title no longer has an icon.
New Clear button in a note removes its text and keeps the title. Clear and Delete both ask first, in a centered alert.
Talk settings has Custom Instructions: tell the assistant how to talk to you, and it applies to every conversation.
The message field in Talk always stays above the keyboard.

releases.title: Tap to Dismiss
notes: New setting, Tap Notification to Dismiss (Alarm settings, off by default): tap the heads-up notification to cancel that ring. Swiping the notification away never dismisses the alarm.

releases.title: Edit To-Dos in Place
notes: Edit to-dos right in the list, like Reminders: tap one to change its title or details, and tap the calendar button for the deadline and more.
To-do details save on their own. No Save button, and the trash icon deletes.
The deadline screen keeps the Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening and Night times under Due, without the suggestions above it, and the date and time are no longer cut off.
Checking off a to-do in the widget shows a checkmark before it disappears.
Choose what the Up Next widget shows: alarms, to-dos with a deadline and to-dos without one (in Alarm and To-Do settings).
Dismissing an alarm early no longer adds a "Skipping" line to it.
Delete All buttons look the same on every tab.
Removed the Ask Assistant button from Control Center. Live Talk is still there, and you can still ask through Siri.

releases.title: Widget Opens Talk
notes: Tapping ✦ on the Up Next widget now opens Alarmie straight to Talk. It's on the medium and large widget sizes.

releases.title: Meet Alarmie
notes: The app is now called Alarmie.
Writing notes is smoother: the page follows your typing, you can tap below the text to keep writing, and the last lines are never hidden behind the keyboard's Done button.
Notes no longer show when they were last edited, and there's more space under the title.
Leaving a note no longer makes the list jump around.
More space under each tab's title, and the text next to the settings button is centered.
Timers always use the same light gray background as the other tabs.
In a to-do, Mark as Done and Delete now sit side by side.
The clock icon sits right next to a to-do's time.
The New To-Do panel closes after you add a to-do.
To-dos without a deadline no longer say "No deadline".

releases.title: Seamless Talk Input
notes: The area around the message field in Talk now has the same gray background as the rest of the tab.

releases.title: Tidier Timers
notes: Removed the Recents heading on the Timers tab. Your recent timers are still listed below any running ones.

releases.title: App Store Updates
notes: Update checks now look on the App Store. When a new version is out, you'll see its release notes and an Update in App Store button.
Talk now uses the same light gray background as the other tabs.

releases.title: Hold to Reorder Notes
notes: Press and hold a note, then drag it onto another to move it there. The separate Reorder button is gone.
Dragging a note into or out of Pinned pins or unpins it.

releases.title: Timer Recents & Delete All
notes: The Timers tab now lists running timers and Recents. Tap ▶ on a recent timer to start it again.
Tap New Timer to set one up in a pop-up sheet, the same way you add an alarm.
Each tab's settings now has Delete All (Alarms, Timers, To-Dos, Notes), with a confirmation first.

releases.title: Simpler Dismiss
notes: Dismissing an alarm no longer leaves an Undo button behind. The card in the app and the row in the widget simply go away, and the alarm shows "Skipping today".

releases.title: Cleaner Note Editor
notes: Copy All and Delete are now simple icons at the top of a note. Delete asks before removing the note.

releases.title: Settings & Notes Order
notes: Every tab has its own settings (the gear next to the title) to choose when you get notified:
Alarms: turn the heads-up on or off and pick 15 min, 30 min, 1 hour or 2 hours before.
Timers: optional notification 1 or 5 minutes before a timer ends.
To-dos: notification at the deadline, plus an optional early reminder (5 min to 1 day before).
Notes: pin notes to the top, Move to Top, drag to rearrange, and sort by Manual, Date Edited, Date Created or Title.
Changing an alarm's time after it rang or was dismissed now lets it ring again at the new time the same day.
Lock screen alarm widgets show zzz when no alarm rings in the next 24 hours.
The next alarm now sits on the same line as the Alarms title. Timers, To-Do and Notes use the same title style, and Talk has no title.
Links the assistant sends in chat now appear as cards on the left, like attachments.
About & Updates moved into settings. This also fixes the info button flickering when switching tabs.
Deadline suggestions are easier to read, in two columns without repeating the day.

releases.title: Widgets Open What You Tap
notes: Tapping the Next Alarm widget now opens that alarm in the app.
Tapping a to-do in the Up Next widget opens it on the To-Do tab. Tapping its circle still checks it off. Alarms and timers open their tabs too.
New quick times for to-do deadlines: Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening and Night. They keep the day you picked, and move to tomorrow if that time has already passed.

releases.title: Notes & Smarter Widget
notes: New Notes tab. Every note has a Copy All button, and you can ask the assistant about your notes or have it write to them.
The To-Do widget is now Up Next. It shows what matters right now: an alarm you can dismiss, running timers and to-dos that are due.
Tap the ✦ button in the corner of the Up Next widget to ask the assistant from your home screen.
Tap a change in the chat (like "Alarm updated") to jump straight to that alarm, to-do or note.
Asking the assistant to change an alarm's days now works reliably, including "weekdays", "mon-fri" and "every day except Sunday".
You now get the 1-hour heads-up even when you set an alarm less than an hour before it rings.
To-dos can have an extra line of detail. Mark as Done is now a button next to Delete.
Alarm times and deadlines are picked in 5-minute steps.
New Alarm, New To-Do and New Note are big buttons at the bottom, easy to reach with your thumb.
Tidier layouts: timer presets and deadline suggestions no longer scroll sideways, the timer wheel labels are evenly spaced, and widget text lines up with its checkboxes.

releases.title: Updates & Patch Notes
notes: The app now checks for new versions and lets you know when an update is ready.
See what changed in every version: tap the info button on the Alarms tab.
A short "What's New" summary appears the first time you open a new version.

releases.title: Control Center
notes: New Ask Assistant control: type or dictate a request from Control Center and get the reply without opening the app.
New Live Talk control: jump straight into hands-free talking.
Ask the assistant through Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts or the Action button.

releases.title: To-Dos & Widgets
notes: New To-Do tab with suggested deadlines like "Tonight" or "Tomorrow morning", plus custom times.
Get a notification at each deadline, with Mark as Done and Remind Me in 1 Hour buttons.
New To-Do widget for the home and lock screen: check items off without opening the app.
The Next Alarm widget now comes in a home screen size.
The assistant can now create, change and delete alarms and to-dos, and change your settings.

releases.title: Timers & Talk
notes: New Timers tab. Timers ring even in Silent mode and count down on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island.
New Talk tab: a private assistant that runs on your iPhone. Chat by text, or talk hands-free with Live Talk.
Optional wake word, so Live Talk only answers when you start with it.
The assistant can start, list and cancel timers.

releases.title: Smarter Dismiss
notes: Dismissing the next ring of a repeating alarm is more reliable and no longer needs you to open the app afterwards.

releases.title: First Release
notes: Alarms for any days of the week that ring like the built-in Clock app, even in Silent mode.
Lock screen widget showing when your next alarm goes off.
A heads-up notification 1 hour before each alarm, with a button to dismiss that ring.
Open the app within the hour to dismiss it from there too.
